demos.name: Demo field guide LAB
demos.description: A JSON-driven card-deck handoff page: edit data/cards.json (title, base URL, sections, cards) and the page renders it. Genericized from the AI-DEMO2 personal-agents handoff page; no baked-in routes or credentials. Each deployment points at its own demo surfaces.
demos.notes: Edit data/cards.json, npm run build, restart. Static server: GET only, loopback-only, zero dependencies, no outbound calls. No credentials on the page by design (build validates and refuses credential-shaped text in cards).
